history_necessity_tests: none in M3215: scripted oracle/seeker VoI measurement only; learned-estimator substitution tests are WP1
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Pre-reveal ramp identification window (drive-side onset for family 2, brake/drive for family 1) under per-cell degraded sensing; detection latency measured separately on sub-limit ramps as the bridge input.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: G-A fail or bridge falsification is reported as written with no threshold weakening; the plan's pre-registered fallback routes apply (family-specific scoping; bridge demotion to direct measurement).
allowed_claims: pre-registered feasibility-audit VoI measurement outcomes on the two scripted task families and the bridge verdict only

decision_rule: Pass only if the --full run completes end to end with the pre-registered criteria echoed into summary.json, both families measured at >= 120 validation episodes per arm per cell with Wilson CIs, and deterministic G-A and bridge verdicts recorded; the verdicts then route per the frozen outcome routes (G-A pass -> WP1 on both families, G-A fail -> family-specific fallback with WP1 on family 1; bridge fail -> demote bridge to direct measurement) with no threshold weakening and all claim boundaries preserved.
